escalation.reason: VERDICT on the wave's Task A lead: mechanism CONFIRMED, exemption claim REFUTED, fix already shipped. (1) CONFIRMED: LibClassicSwingTimerAPI.lua:596-604 restarts BOTH melee hands on any tracked cast completion, and Auto Shot 75 sets unit.casting=true; on Era, Anniversary and Titanforge the real library fires START:mainhand + START:offhand + START:ranged for START(75)+SUCCEEDED(75). (2) REFUTED: no noreset_swing_spells table contains 75 (bands 996-1044, 1115-1167, 1380-1448, 1525-1560, 1629-1668, 1703-1713); every [75] line is inside a ranged_swing table. Steady 34120 is exempt on Anniversary and Titanforge (so the lead's 'Steady leaks' half is wrong for both), and the lib lane's 2026-10-25 change has since exempted Multi/Aimed/Arcane/Serpent on all three branches. (3) The remaining Auto Shot leak is already fixed in scope: classes/hunter.lua suppress_auto_shot_melee_reset arms the engine's own preventSwingReset during an Auto Shot cast at range, real-lib proven and killed by mutations M2/M3. A lib noreset entry for 75 is REJECTED (it would also kill the in-melee reset the reference deliberately keeps, SuperSwingTimer_State.lua:1516-1536) and a main.lua snapshot/restore is REJECTED (a cast-reset START is payload-identical to a real swing START).
escalation.blocked_on: One operator design ruling, nothing functional: should a completed Auto Shot cast AT MELEE RANGE delay the melee swing? Shipped answer = YES (the reference rule; the guard only suppresses at range). Alternative = never reset melee on any hunter shot, a one-line change in the guard's melee branch.
escalation.recommendation: Keep the shipped reference rule unless the operator wants hunter shots never to delay melee; if they do, it is one line (remove the in-melee early return) plus one test flip, and this desk can be re-dispatched for it. No lib edit, no main.lua edit, no hands-up needed on the mechanism itself.
